summary.en: Turning creator needs into AI-powered marketing workflows.
summary.zh: 将创作者需求转化为 AI 营销工作流。

body.en: At Qwen, I worked on the development and international launch of Qwen Create, an AI-agent product for end-to-end marketing workflows.
body.zh: 在千问，我参与 Qwen Create 从开发到海外上线的过程，将创作者需求转化为端到端的 AI 营销工作流。

contribution.en: My work included defining a multi-agent product architecture and evaluation across model quality, planning, execution, and end-to-end task success.
contribution.zh: 我的工作包括定义多 Agent 产品架构，以及围绕模型质量、规划、执行和端到端任务完成度建立评测。

focus.zh: 多 Agent 工作流 · 评测

summary.en: Making campus equipment easier to share.
summary.zh: 让校园设备共享更便捷。

body.en: Co-Hive is a hardware-software campus sharing platform developed with Brown University and RISD. It connects smart lockers, real-time device synchronization, and a consumer borrowing experience.
body.zh: Co-Hive 是与布朗大学和 RISD 合作开发的校园共享平台，将智能储物柜、实时设备同步与用户借还体验连接起来。

contribution.en: I led product development from user research to launch, using usability testing and behavioral data to improve the scan, borrow, return, and rewards journey.
contribution.zh: 我负责从用户研究到上线的产品开发，通过可用性测试与行为数据改进扫码、借用、归还和奖励流程。

focus.zh: 用户研究 · 产品与服务设计
